findings.problem: The Kentucky locality-of-work mapper sources its LEX row with the tag dd.ky.locality.lexington = '... occupational license fee of 2.25% on an individual's compensation ...'. That puts a local tax rate, a system constant, into master data, where it will go stale at the next rate change. The DD only needs the locality to exist.

_builder_decisions.C29_X_run_masks: ACCEPTED as authority format masks, quoted verbatim. 'S-XXXXXX-Y': SSA Pub. 42-007 EFW2 TY2026 4.2.6 (US-FEDS5-032 copy: 'The Employer Signature PIN must follow this exact format: S-XXXXXX-Y ... each X is a digit 0-9'). 'WHTXXXXXXXX': Vermont RS layout (US-VTS6-001 copy: 'Use the account ID (WHT-XXXXXXXX) assigned to you. Be sure to omit the hyphen. Example: WHTXXXXXXXX'). The shared C29 sanctions authority reference masks, but its regex only recognises digit- or dot-adjacent runs, so these letter- or hyphen-adjacent masks will still be listed: a checker limitation, to be carried to run close like the C46 one. QA does not write a validation exemption; recording one is the owner's decision.
